summary:
**Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer**

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive website designed to make space learning exciting for students. It includes astronaut training modules, space missions, outpost survival, NASA Live information, and educational games. Students can earn XP points, track their progress, and compete through a leaderboard. The website also features Astro AI, an intelligent mission assistant powered by Gemini and NASA data, which helps students understand missions, get hints, and explore space-related topics. The main goal is to combine education and gaming to help young learners improve their space knowledge, curiosity, and problem-solving skills while enjoying an astronaut-like learning experience.
details:
Our project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, is a website that helps students learn about space and understand what astronauts do during their missions. We wanted to make space learning more interesting instead of just giving students information to read.

In our website, users can explore different astronaut training activities, such as spacecraft operations, spacewalks, robotics, scientific research and emergency situations. We have also added mission challenges where users can try to solve problems that astronauts might face in space.

One of the features we worked on is Outpost Survival. In this section, users can select a space location and try to manage important resources like food, power and life support. We also included NASA-related space information, educational games, quizzes, a leaderboard and an AI assistant called Astro AI.

We created this project to make students more curious about space science. Through these activities, they can learn by exploring, answering questions and taking on challenges. Our aim is to make learning enjoyable and encourage more young people to take an interest in astronomy and space exploration.

We developed it as a website using HTML, CSS and JavaScript (if these are the technologies your team used). While building it, we focused on making the website easy to use, interesting for students and useful for learning. The creative part of our project is bringing astronaut training, space missions, survival activities and games together in one platform.
